theory: Conversations consist of observations with different authority: deltas draw the interface, final replies settle the answer, and result events report spend. Adapters preserve those distinctions while the harness-owned loop can decline another model call.
instead_of: A universal SDK conversation would hide the different control and isolation guarantees of hosted loops and the harness-owned loop.

absorption.rationale: Provider extension fits; durable resume and SDK-controlled budgets still need transport-specific changes.

world_mapping.rationale: Events, call identifiers and usage reports correspond to observable conversation facts.

abstraction.rationale: The neutral loop is substitutable, but adapters retain distinct conversation and cancellation semantics.

justification.rationale: The ledger explains why cumulative reports cannot simply be added.

honest_limits.rationale: Missing spend stays distinct from zero; cancellation does not unwind arbitrary tool work.

rehearsals.requirement: Add a provider using the existing event vocabulary
rehearsals.why: Implement the provider adapter and inject the dispatcher.

rehearsals.requirement: Persist the harness-owned conversation across process restarts
rehearsals.why: Its message history is memory-owned, while SDK backends expose different resume identities.
Reporting coverage is already per field rather than inferred from a total.
